concerns.text: FR-004 mandates outlier removal using a Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) rule, but the Assumptions section (and Edge Cases) describe outlier removal as "±3 σ". The two statistical definitions are not equivalent, creating a direct contradiction about the required outlier‑removal method.

SC-006 requires the final dataset to contain ≥ 200 rows, yet FR-010 provides a fallback procedure for n < 200 (use Wilcoxon test). If the success criterion enforces ≥ 200 rows, the fallback will never be reachable, making FR-010’s conditional logic contradictory to the success criteria.
